info.name: Cvent REST APIs — Event Cloud Usage API

params.name: before
params.description:
Returns usage for the seven days before (inclusive) the date provided. If after is also provided, then
only the dates between (inclusive) those dates are returned. before must be a valid ISO8601 date stamp.
before and after must not be more then seven days apart.

params.name: after
params.description:
Returns usage for the seven days after (inclusive) the date provided. If before is also provided, then
only the dates between (inclusive) those dates are returned. after must be a valid ISO8601 date stamp.
after and before must not be more then seven days apart.

items.docs:
Returns API call usage for the last seven days, or between some date range (up to the past seven days) for
the current caller's account.
Returns the current usage tier of the caller's account.
